title: 第13章 先天剑种显威第14章 灭秦家追寻父亲死因
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 轰！
天刀宗李长老，实力极强，已经达到了半步元丹境。
一个秦惊蛰，秦易还能应付，但加上李长老的话，就有些难了。
轰！
被两人联手围剿，秦易不断后退。
秦易连续催动《离火剑术》，手中木剑不断挥舞，一道道璀璨剑光，纵横交错，想要逼退两人。
扑哧！
秦惊蛰毕竟年迈，而且境界跌落，稍微分神，就被秦易一剑劈中，一条胳膊瞬间断裂，鲜血喷洒。
此时的他，没有疼痛，满脑子都是恨意。
自己的儿子，孙子，全部死于秦易之手，他就算拼了老命，也要报仇。
天刀宗李长老，手掌猛地一劈，顿时一记手刀出现。
他施展的《断刀术》比秦策厉害百倍。
轰！
木剑与手刀相撞，迸发出炙热的火光，秦易纵身一跃，躲避开了李长老的攻击。
继续这样下去，也不是办法。
本想灭掉秦家，但是有天刀宗李长老在，估计是不行了。
秦易心生退意，准备先行撤退。
然而。
就在关键时刻。
突然，青云城上空，一道恐怖的剑光，横穿天地，劈在大地上，地板直接龟裂，剑气纵横，令人心颤。
嗯？
突如其来的剑光，逼停了战斗。
天刀宗李长老猛地抬头，森然道：“什么时候你天剑宗，也爱多管闲事了？”
说话间。
一个身穿粗布衣，腰间挂着酒壶，满脸络腮胡子的老头，凭空出现。
众人皆惊。
江州境内，总共有两大顶尖势力，被尊称为仙宗。
分别是天刀宗与天剑宗。
这两大势力一直以来，都是死对头。
没想到今日，两大势力的人，居然齐聚青云城。
“你好歹也是天刀宗的长老，居然自降身份，对付一个初入炼脉境的小家伙？”酒壶老者咧嘴笑道。
“哼，你最好不要多管闲事。”天刀宗李长老冷声道。
酒壶老者摇头，“今天这个闲事，我还管定了。”
说着，他走到秦易面前，咧嘴一笑，说道：“我是天剑宗七长老，如果我没猜错的话，你应该是秦天豹的儿子吧？”
嗯？
秦易微惊，天剑宗长老怎么会认识自己的父亲。
“前辈，您认识我父亲？”秦易急忙问道。
七长老道：“你父亲他，其实也是我天剑宗弟子，只是……”
content_en:
boom!
Elder Li of the Tiandao Sect is extremely powerful and has reached the half-step Yuan Dan realm.
Qin Yi could still handle Qin Jingzhe, but with Elder Li's words, it would be a bit difficult.
boom!
Being surrounded and suppressed by the two men, Qin Yi kept retreating.
Qin Yi continuously activated "Lihuo Swordsmanship", waving the wooden sword in his hand continuously, and bright sword lights crisscrossed, trying to force the two men back.
Phew!
After all, Qin Jingzhe was old and his level had declined. He was slightly distracted when he was hit by Qin Yi's sword. One of his arms was broken instantly and blood sprayed out.
"Damn..."
At this time, he felt no pain, and his mind was filled with hatred.
His sons and grandsons all died at the hands of Qin Yi. He would take revenge even if he risked his life.
"Kill."
Elder Li of the Heavenly Sword Sect slashed with his palm, and a hand knife appeared immediately.
The "Breaking Sword Technique" he performed was a hundred times more powerful than Qin Ce.
boom!
The wooden sword collided with the hand knife, bursting out with hot fire. Qin Yi jumped up and avoided Elder Li's attack.
Continuing like this is not an option.
I originally wanted to destroy the Qin family, but with Elder Li of the Tiandao Sect here, I guess it won't be possible.
Qin Yi wanted to retreat and was ready to retreat first.
However.
Just in the nick of time.
Suddenly, in the sky above Qingyun City, a terrifying sword light traveled across the sky and earth, striking the ground. The floor cracked directly, and the sword energy was vertical and horizontal, making people's hearts tremble.
Um?
The sudden sword light forced the battle to stop.
Elder Li of the Heavenly Sword Sect suddenly raised his head and said solemnly: "When did you, the Heavenly Sword Sect, become nosy?"
While talking.
An old man wearing coarse cloth, with a wine bottle hanging on his waist, and a full beard appeared out of thin air.
Everyone was shocked.
There are two top forces in Jiangzhou, which are respectfully called Immortal Sect.
They are the Heavenly Sword Sect and the Heavenly Sword Sect.
These two major forces have always been mortal enemies.
Unexpectedly, people from the two major forces would gather in Qingyun City today.
"After all, you are also an elder of the Tiandao Sect, but you actually lower yourself to deal with a little guy who has just entered the Pulse Refining Realm?" the old man with a grin said.
"Hmph, you'd better stop meddling in other people's business." Elder Li of the Tiandao Sect said coldly.
The old man with the jug shook his head, "I'm still taking care of today's noisy matters."
With that said, he walked up to Qin Yi, grinned, and said, "I am the seventh elder of Tianjian Sect. If I guess correctly, you should be Qin Tianbao's son, right?"
Huh?
Qin Yi was slightly shocked, how could the elder of Tianjian Sect know his father.
"Senior, do you know my father?" Qin Yi asked hurriedly.
The seventh elder said: "Your father is actually a disciple of my Tianjian Sect, but..."
title_en: Chapter 13 The Innate Sword Seed Shows Its Power Chapter 14 Destroying the Qin Family and Finding the Cause of Father’s Death
